assumptions.text: ScreeningService.screen returns a dict containing a numeric 'risk_index' field, and any other error modes besides raising ScreeningUnavailableError are out of scope and will not occur.

The risk band thresholds ACCEPT_MAX, REVIEW_MIN, REVIEW_MAX, and REFUSE_MIN exist as numeric constants and partition the risk index space without gaps or overlap; this module defines placeholder values (ACCEPT_MAX=41.0, REVIEW_MIN=42.0, REVIEW_MAX=66.0, REFUSE_MIN=67.0) solely to make control flow testable.
Boundary handling for risk bands follows standard inclusive/exclusive logic: risk_index <= ACCEPT_MAX -> accept; REVIEW_MIN <= risk_index <= REVIEW_MAX -> review; risk_index >= REFUSE_MIN -> refuse.
QuoteStore.store_draft returns a unique string quote_id on success; QuoteStore.update_quote returns an updated quote representation that this implementation does not need to inspect.
NotificationService.send_quote_document and send_refusal_notice are fire-and-forget operations whose failures, if any, are not surfaced to QuoteAPI (consistent with the fire-and-forget semantic).
